subject: Mutual action rhythm — Northbridge security acceptance, SOC 2 + DPA retention carve-outs
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@northbridge.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial security intake & MAP request — Northbridge evaluation

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Northbridge is ready to formalize the mutual action plan (MAP) for the upcoming evaluation — our security and procurement teams need a concrete acceptance cadence and a draft DPA with retention details to present to leadership. High level asks from our side: SOC 2 Type II report (or summary), completed SIG/CAIQ answers, a draft DPA we can redline, and a retention matrix for embeddings/logs/ backups.

Target timeframe: procurement hopes to reach commercial sign by end of March if security gates are satisfied. Can you confirm what evidence you can provide and a recommended MAP with milestone dates? Also please note we require an answer on EU data residency options and KMS integration for keys.

Attachments: Northbridge-security-intake-2026.xlsx (questionnaire stub)

Regards,
Olivia Park
Head of Information Security
Northbridge Financial
olivia.park@northbridge.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@northbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 12:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial security intake & MAP request — Northbridge evaluation

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to put a MAP together and align dates to Northbridge's end-of-March target. Quick summary of what we can provide immediately:

- SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf) and secure link to full report for an approved exchange.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ answers (redwood-sig-answers-2026.csv).
- Draft DPA we typically send as a DocuSign/trackable link (we can accept redlines).
- Retention matrix (redwood-data-retention-matrix.xlsx) describing configurable windows by deployment mode.

Suggested MAP milestones (draft):
1) Feb 25: Security working session (30 min) — intake Qs + residency/KMS discussion
2) Mar 3: Delivery of SOC2 evidence pack + SIG answers to Northbridge security
3) Mar 10: DPA redline exchange (DocuSign) and retention carveout negotiation
4) Mar 17: Final security acceptance sign-off (or list of remaining risk items)
5) Mar 24: Procurement/contract signature target

We can provide EU residency options (hosted EU regions) and a private deployment variant for contractual isolation. We support AWS KMS and GCP KMS integrations (customer-managed). For retention: hosted API defaults are short-lived caches/embeddings retention by policy, we can pin production retention to 30/90/365-day buckets depending on your risk appetite — I'll include granular options in the matrix.

I've attached the three items noted above and a draft MAP CSV (MAP-v1.csv) that includes milestone owners and acceptance criteria. Are you available Feb 25 at 10:00am PT for the working session?

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Security & Trust (Redwood Inference)
irene.choi@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf; redwood-sig-answers-2026.csv; redwood-data-retention-matrix.xlsx; MAP-v1.csv
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@northbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Galvez <alex.galvez@procurecorp.io>, procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial security intake & MAP request — Northbridge evaluation

Thanks, Irene — Feb 25 at 10:00am PT works for our team. A couple of clarifying items in advance of the session:
- Retention expectations: procurement will push for logs retained 12 months, with the option to reduce to 90 days for certain environments. Embeddings retention is a big ask — can you confirm default retention for hosted API and options to purge or escrow embeddings after conclusion of evaluation?
- Residency & KMS: our legal/compliance prefer contractual EU residency for any customer data processed for EU customers. Is private deployment the only way to guarantee EU-only processing, or can Redwood hosted EU regions with contractual SOW suffice?

Procurement (cc'd) will join the call to confirm commercial levers.

Olivia
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@northbridge.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial security intake & MAP request — Northbridge evaluation

Hi Olivia — quick answers ahead of Thursday's working session so your procurement/legal teammates have clarity:

- Embeddings retention: hosted API default is 30 days for embeddings and inference cache; we offer configurable retention windows (30/90/365) and a contractual purge clause after evaluation. For strict no-retention needs we recommend our Dedicated or Private deployments where retention is customer-controlled.
- Logs & backups: standard logs retained 90 days; we can extend to 12 months with a commercial addendum. Backups follow region/provider policies; we can add retention clauses in the DPA.
- EU residency & KMS: hosted in an EU region + contractual residency commitment is possible for many customers, but the only way to ensure absolute physical isolation is Private deployment. Customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP) is supported for key separation; we can document the key lifecycle in the DPA.

I've uploaded a DPA draft and a redline template to DocuSign for traceability (DPA-redline-v1.docx). I'll populate the MAP-v1.csv with explicit owners and deadlines after our working session.

See you Feb 25, 10:00am PT.

Cheers,
Irene
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 16:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Action: SOC2 evidence handoff + MAP updates (Northbridge)

Laura/Jonas/Ben — following the working session with Northbridge, they confirmed the MAP and want the SOC2 evidence pack and SIG artifacts by Mar 3, and they'd like the first DPA redline by Mar 10. Please prioritize the following:
1) Laura: compile SOC2 evidence pack (logs retention diagrams, access control matrix, recent penetration test summary). Hand off to security@northbridge via the secure link and notify me when uploaded.
2) Jonas: finalize SIG answers and any open control notes; ensure items are mapped to the evidence pack.
3) Ben: coordinate DPA redline delivery and ensure the EU residency/KMS language options are present in the draft.

We need the MAP-v1.csv updated with the confirmed dates and owners before Mar 1 so Olivia's procurement can include it in their package.

Thanks — short standup Monday if needed.

Irene
